description: MENU 02 - central de navegacao em cards para os dashboards disponiveis da LOGNET.

options.css: :host{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;overflow:hidden}.nav-root{width:100%;height:100%;min-height:620px;background:#1a1d24;color:#f4f7fb;font-family:Inter,Arial,sans-serif;padding:24px 28px;box-sizing:border-box}.hdr{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;padding-bottom:22px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.09)}.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;min-width:0}.logo{height:46px;max-width:154px;object-fit:contain;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 6px rgba(255,255,255,.25))}.title{min-width:0;border-left:6px solid #f97316;padding-left:16px}.title h1{margin:0;color:#fff;font-size:18px;font-weight:900;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0}.title p{margin:4px 0 0;color:#9aa4b2;font-size:12px;font-weight:700}.live{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;border:1px solid rgba(34,197,94,.28);border-radius:999px;background:rgba(34,197,94,.08);padding:7px 12px;color:#86efac;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;white-space:nowrap}.live-dot{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:#22c55e;box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(34,197,94,.65);animation:blink 2s ease-in-out infinite}@keyframes blink{0%,100%{opacity:1}50%{opacity:.4}}.section{margin-top:26px}.section-title{margin:0 0 12px;color:#8b949e;font-size:11px;font-weight:900;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em}.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(250px,1fr));gap:14px}.card{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;min-height:82px;padding:16px;border-radius:8px;background:#12151c;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);text-decoration:none;color:#fff;transition:transform .15s ease,border-color .15s ease,box-shadow .15s ease}.card:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);border-color:var(--c);box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.34)}.icon{width:42px;height:42px;flex:0 0 42px;display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:8px;color:var(--c);background:var(--bg);border:1px solid var(--bd)}.icon svg{width:22px;height:22px;display:block}.txt{min-width:0}.txt strong{display:block;font-size:15px;font-weight:900;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}.txt span{display:block;margin-top:4px;color:#9aa4b2;font-size:12px;font-weight:650;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}@media(max-width:760px){.nav-root{padding:18px;min-height:720px}.hdr{align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column}.grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.logo{height:38px}.title h1{font-size:16px}}
